attributes.residual: THE POINT OF THIS RECORD IS THE RECLASSIFICATION, NOT THE FUZZY GAIN. The pin mechanism stored in config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json for next_boss_hint ends with: 'NOTE for a future lane: the third sibling next_rune_hint is NOT a member - every window tried refuses at step 0 with `breaks def-use chains: [(N,(g,5))]`, C1's recolor-induced-displacement class.' That refusal was correct and is now obsolete. BEFORE: 96/96 with a genuine one-position DISPLACEMENT -- ours issued `slw` at +0x10c and formed the gPlayers ADDR16_LO address at +0x110, the target the reverse -- which is why every permutation window refused: the displacement was entangled with the colouring. AFTER: the source change moves the address materialisation ahead of the shift, the instruction ORDER now matches the target word-for-word across the whole function (fndiff --ops prints ZERO clusters), and regnorm certifies CLEAN-RENAMING with 0 STRUCTURAL and 0 unpaired rows. The 9 surviving renaming rows are: +0x0fc T lwz r4,0(r3) / O lwz r3,0(r3); +0x100 T lis r3 / O lis r5; +0x104 T li r0,1 / O li r4,1; +0x108 T addi r4,r4,-1 / O addi r0,r3,-1; +0x10c T addi r6,r3,0 / O addi r5,r5,0; +0x110 T slw r5,r0,r4 / O slw r6,r4,r0; +0x11c T add r7,r6,r3 / O add r7,r5,r3; +0x134 and +0x150 T and. r0,r0,r5 / O and. r0,r6,r0. next_rune_hint is therefore now a copy_register_fields-ONLY candidate needing no permutation stage at all -- the same single stage that already closes DrawGlowText in btext.c. ONE HONEST CAVEAT: regnorm's CLEAN-RENAMING is a live-range-aware verdict and is NOT the same check as webfrank's position-lockstep verify_consistent_recolor; note that the target's r3 maps to O r5 at +0x100/+0x10c but to O r3 at +0x11c, i.e. target r3 carries TWO distinct webs here. The WF lane must run verify_consistent_recolor itself rather than inherit this verdict, and if it refuses, AGENTS.md discipline 14 applies -- instrument WHICH check fired on WHICH word before recording it as a fact about the function.
